company.shortDescription: Dorsia is a members-only platform that offers reservations at in-demand restaurants in major cities
company.description: Dorsia is a members-only platform that offers reservations at in-demand restaurants in major cities. The platform utilizes technology to enhance experiences for both operators and members, ensuring smooth booking without stress. Dorsia operates in various cities, including Miami, Los Angeles, Dubai, and San Francisco, making it a versatile choice for food enthusiasts.
